commits.message: refactor(cli): tidy legion threads resolve after review (LEGION-34 fast-follow)

changes: githubGraphql: `payload.data == null` guard (GraphQL `data: null` is legal).

review-threads.ts owns the policy: resolveAcceptedThreads(graphql, repo, number, log) is the former cmdThreadsResolve loop, plus parseRepo/parsePullNumber; GITHUB_GRAPHQL_URL, isAcceptance, acceptedByOpener, listUnresolvedThreads, resolveThread, UnresolvedThread are module-private. cmdThreadsResolve in index.ts is parse -> redeemGitHubToken -> githubGraphql -> resolveAcceptedThreads (redeemGitHubToken stays in index.ts, shared with cmdGh — moving it would drag daemonUrl/grantFrom/readSecretPointer along, beyond the named scope).

Unit pins: exact `no unresolved threads` with zero mutations when every thread is already resolved; malformed --repo / --pr rejected with the exact message before any request reaches the daemon (github.requests empty).
